target.statement: ISER-S achieves an average AUC-ROC of 0.8805 on the glass dataset, the best score in that row among all 14 compared methods (iForest 0.8016, ISER-A 0.8730, ADERH 0.8643).
target.table_ref: Table III, row 'glass', column 'ISER-S' (headline AUC-ROC comparison table)
target.dataset: glass (214 samples, 7 features, 9 anomalies, 4.21% contamination; PyOD/ODDS benchmark)

compute.basis: ISER is a purely CPU, distance-based isolation ensemble (O(t*psi^2) fit, O(n*psi*t) inference) with no neural training; the glass benchmark is 214x7, and even a full sweep over psi in {2,...,128} with t=200 and 5 repeats finishes in seconds after a pip install and a free ODDS/PyOD data download.

title: Isolation-based Spherical Ensemble Representations for Tabular Anomaly Detection
